item.title: D-Wave and Nasdaq Verafin Partner to Develop Quantum Applications for Financial Crime Detection
item.summary: Quantum computing developer D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) has signed an agreement with Nasdaq Verafin—the financial crime management technology unit of Nasdaq—to evaluate the use of quantum-hybrid computing in combating financial crime.
